clock.window_evidence: start = the session's first fetch_page call on the source URL; end = the last of the 8 chunk fetches (chunks 1..8 read in order, single pass). The fetch tool exposes no per-call clock, so the window is bounded by the claim commit and the manifest write, and is recorded as a window, not per-read times.

method.how: all 8 chunks of the page read in one pass with the page-fetch tool; every printed table row transcribed in page order; blanks preserved as blanks; club attribution as printed by the page; chunk-boundary rows reconstructed from the two printed halves of the row
method.limitation: the sha256 hashes above seal the committed transcript, not the page's raw HTML bytes; byte-level HTTP capture with header clocks begins with the CI collector
